_readme: Provenance for every image a Royal Palm Beach blog article may reference. The only verified Royal Palm Beach-area photography is the Pines Natural Area pair (CC BY 2.0). Every other image is illustrative stock chosen by subject, not by place, and must be captioned as illustrative and never described as a Royal Palm Beach location. Enforced by scripts/audit-city-images.mjs (runs before every build).

images.source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pine_flatwoods_001_by_Scott_Zona.jpg and _002; Commons description: "Royal Palm Beach Pines Natural Area, Palm Beach County, Florida, USA." Originals 3648x2736, cropped and resized.
images.verification: Wikimedia Commons description names the Royal Palm Beach Pines Natural Area, which Palm Beach County ERM lists under Royal Palm Beach (discover.pbc.gov/erm/NaturalAreas/Royal-Palm-Beach-Pines.aspx). Whether the preserve lies inside Village limits is not claimed. Pine flatwoods with saw palmetto; no people.
